title: Local environments to get around locked pkg environment
description:
Should be merged after #7

Move the object definition inside a local env to allow for the value to change after the package is loaded.

Ex:

```r
library(autocogs)
library(pkgThatAddsKnownCogGroups)
```

Before the PR, I'd bet that it'd fail.  Now it should be ok.

title: Updates for ggplot2 v3.3.0
description:
All changes should be backwards compatible.  The only one that worries me is changing the data.frames to tibbles... but that's never a bad thing, right?

The only update due to ggplot2 directly is they dropped the formula in geom_smooth and then produce a default value message because it wasn't provided.  I don't like this change. 😞

title: Update maintainer and README figure location
Remove dependency on rJava (via scagnostics)
description: I removed the scagnostics dependency since for some reason a lot of systems lately have been having trouble with rJava. I don't use the scagnostics that much and I think it's okay for now to remove them. I just kept "monotonic" since that's easy to compute without the scagnostics package. If the non-java scagnostics gets revived or there are other options, we can put full support back in. What do you think, @schloerke?
